name: The Rumormonger
summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard now has a question about Nazz Steamboil. The goblin racer pilot once used another name, and Kravel wonders whether the secret could bring profit. He sends you to Krazek in Booty Bay, who may know.

sections.title: A Name Worth Asking About
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard says the goblins are next in line for a favor. He has heard that Nazz Steamboil, the goblin racer pilot, once used another name. Why did it change? Might Nazz be keeping a secret? Kravel believes Krazek knows the truth. You can find Krazek at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay, at Stranglethorn's southern tip. Useful information might turn a profit.

sections.title: Krazek's Answer
sections.body: Krazek knows Nazz Steamboil as a racer pilot on the Shimmering Flats. He says the truth may be uncovered, but it will take effort, time, and money.

faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard, a dwarf at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats, sends you to Krazek.

faq.q: Why is Kravel interested in Nazz Steamboil?
faq.answer: Kravel heard that Nazz Steamboil, the goblin racer pilot, once used another name. He wonders whether it hides a secret Nazz wants kept, and whether that secret could bring profit.
Krazek is at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay, at the southern tip of Stranglethorn.
It follows Delivery to the Gnomes, after you have done a service for the gnomes.
